issues.note: 39% of voters; voted D+6 after backing Trump in 2024.
4% named foreign policy first; 63% overall disapproved of Iran military action.

say Trump's tariffs have hurt the national economy
say U.S. military action against Iran was the wrong decision; 74% called it a major factor
say inflation caused their family hardship over the past year (21% severe)
say the administration's immigration enforcement has gone too far
